name: @polaris/processor-audiences-v1
description: Polaris audiences runner v1. The runtime shell around @polaris/engage-audiences: reads traits (or a sanctioned projection), asks the library which membership changes the run produces, writes them to audience_memberships and emits audience.entered / audience.exited on profile.events for transitions only. No long-lived service: `polaris audiences compute` is the entrypoint.
